Old Thomas climbed down the iron rungs, his boots crunching upon wet shells. Half-buried in sand lay a heavy green bottle, sealed tight with hardened resin. Inside rested a single slip of parchment, dry as bone. He carried it up to the lantern room, chipped away the wax with a rusted pocketknife, and gently coaxed the rolled paper into the pale morning light. Thomas stared seaward, wondering whose long voyage had finally reached its end.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市尚在沉睡，夜色像浓墨般化开。路灯投下昏黄的光晕，静静铺在空旷的水泥街道上。高耸的大楼熄去了大半灯火，唯有几处孤零零地亮着，守候着未眠的生计。环卫工人的扫帚摩擦着地面，发出沙沙的声响；远处的码头传来隐约的汽笛，在薄雾与寒气中回荡，整座城正静候第一缕晨光。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a rule or task solves a big puzzle by doing one small step and then giving the rest to an identical smaller version of itself.\n- It keeps repeating this same step over and over until it reaches a clear stopping point called the base case.\n- It is just like standing between two mirrors and seeing reflections of reflections stretching out until they finally fade away."}
